mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the sensory and motor fibres was most worthwhile: the cutaway showed how signals travel in opposite directions on separate fibres inside one nerve.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the brain in the skull was clear but predictable; it felt more like straightforward assembly than a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: I was surprised that local spinal cord circuits can produce rapid responses without waiting for a conscious decision.

arbitrary.text: Joining sensory and motor fibres was not fully clear beforehand. The goal and offered pairing guided me, but the result explained that the fibres share a covering rather than merge.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because the pictures made the signal routes clearer, and I would like to see how they connect to muscle movement. The straightforward assembly alone was less engaging.
